Lessons.Title: Angles
ExplanationParagraphs: An angle consists of two rays with shared vertex. Standard position places vertex at origin, initial ray on positive x-axis and terminal ray after a directed rotation.
Counterclockwise rotation is positive and clockwise negative. Angles that differ by integer multiples of360° or2π are coterminal.
One radian subtends an arc equal in length to the circle radius; 180°=πrad, so multiply degrees byπ/180 to get radians.
Quadrantal angles terminate on axes; common special angles 30°,45°,60°,90° have exact π fractions.
Given arc radius r>0 and angle θ in radians, s=rθ; the geometric length is nonnegative for arc magnitude |θ|.
A sector with central angle θ≥0 radians has area A=(1/2)r²θ. Always convert degree measure to radians before applying this formula.
Angular speed ω=Δθ/Δt in rad/time; linear speed v=rω in distance/time. Convert wheel revolutions per minute to radians per time unit.
Independent Cool-down: convert−210° to radians, find arc length r=4cm θ=3π/4, and find wheel RPM for ω=πrad/s.
Independent Try It 1: Sketch negative −60° in standard position.
Independent Try It 2: A circle radius6m has 12m arc. Find radian angle.
Independent Try It 3: Convert 7π/4 to degrees.
Independent Try It 4: Convert 225° to radians.
Independent Try It 8: Find arc length r=3cm θ=5π/6.
Independent Try It 9: Find sector area r=5in θ=π/3.
Independent Try It 10: A fan makes 3 rotations in 2s. Find angular speed.
Independent Try It 11: Wheel radius0.5m spinning4rad/s: find v.

KeyConcepts.Title: Directed standard angle
KeyConcepts.Definition: Vertex at origin, initial ray along +x, terminal ray determined by oriented angle.

KeyConcepts.Title: Radians
KeyConcepts.Definition: θ=s/r; 2π radians is one full revolution.

KeyConcepts.Title: Arc and sector
KeyConcepts.Definition: For θ≥0 in radians, s=rθ and A=r²θ/2.
KeyConcepts.Rule: Keep linear vs square units distinct.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Treat negative rotation as negative physical arc length.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: Directed displacement can be negative, physical distance cannot.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Use magnitude when the question asks distance.
